# AUTOGENERATED COPYRIGHT HEADER END
project(compiler)
add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME})
init_project(${PROJECT_NAME})

target_sources(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
	"source/main.cpp"
	"source/lexer.hpp"
	"source/lexer.cpp"
	"source/error.hpp"
	"source/error.cpp"
	"source/parser.hpp"
	"source/parser.cpp"
	"source/util.hpp"
	"source/util.cpp"
	"source/types.hpp"
	"source/types.cpp"
	"source/compiler.hpp"
	"source/compiler.cpp"
	"source/ast/ast.hpp"
)

target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
	"${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/source"
)

# The runtime library has to live next to the compiler, which links it into every program it produces.
add_dependencies(${PROJECT_NAME} blitzrt)
add_custom_command(TARGET ${PROJECT_NAME} POST_BUILD
	COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${PROJECT_NAME}>/runtime"
	COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "$<TARGET_FILE:blitzrt>" ${BLITZRT_LIBRARIES} "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${PROJECT_NAME}>/runtime/"
)

get_target_property(_SOURCES ${PROJECT_NAME} SOURCES)
source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${_SOURCES})


# Tests: every program in /tests has to compile into an executable, the lexer test only has to lex.
enable_testing()
set(TEST_DIRECTORY "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/../tests")
foreach(_TEST IN ITEMS 001 002 003 004 005 006 007)
	add_test(
		NAME "compile-${_TEST}"
		COMMAND ${PROJECT_NAME} "${TEST_DIRECTORY}/${_TEST}.bb" -o "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/test-${_TEST}${CMAKE_EXECUTABLE_SUFFIX}"
	)
	set_tests_properties("compile-${_TEST}" PROPERTIES FIXTURES_SETUP "program-${_TEST}")
	# Run the programs too. Without a window, so that this also works on machines without a display or GPU.
	add_test(
		NAME "run-${_TEST}"
		COMMAND "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/test-${_TEST}${CMAKE_EXECUTABLE_SUFFIX}"
	)
	set_tests_properties("run-${_TEST}" PROPERTIES FIXTURES_REQUIRED "program-${_TEST}" ENVIRONMENT "BLITZ_HEADLESS=1")
endforeach()
add_test(
	NAME "lex-test"
	COMMAND ${PROJECT_NAME} --dump-tokens "${TEST_DIRECTORY}/test.bb"
)
